eax: Accumulator register, used for arithmetic operations.
ebx: Base register, often used as a pointer to data.
ecx: Counter register, used in loop operations.
edx: Data register, used in I/O operations.
esi: Source index register, used in string operations.
edi: Destination index register, used in string operations.
esp: Stack pointer register, points to the top of the stack.
ebp: Base pointer register, points to the base of the stack frame.
